description: Image Description: The image shows a large, brown and white speckled cattle with prominent, long curved horns. The animal is standing in a field of tall green grass. Its body is mostly brown with irregular white patches. The focus is mainly on the head and horns of the cattle, which are the most striking features. In the background, there are more cattle with similar coloration, partially visible among the grass. The scene is outdoors, likely in a pasture or farm setting, with natural lighting.
